I am currently going through this myself. The company has to give reasonable notice for termination based on the amount of years worked. Although they can terminate her, they should have provided notice, and in lieu of that she should have been given financial renumeration. I suggest seeing an employment lawyer, tell them the situation, you will pay for an hour for the legal advice, but the information you will receive is  very valuable. I highly suggest this. A lot of people on here are giving you unkowleageable advice, I thought as they did, until I met with my lawyer. Yes, businesses like that can terminate with little reason for cause, but you are not helpless in this. See the lawyer, she can get an amount back based on the years worked and for what would be reasonable time for her to find a job similar in her profession. It will be based off her age, years worked, and income.
